claims: The 2026 NHL Playoffs are set to begin on April 18, 2026.
The 2026 NHL Playoffs feature a 16-team format.
The 2026 NHL Playoffs feature four rounds.
The 2026 NHL Playoffs feature best-of-seven series.
The best-of-seven series use a 2-2-1-1-1 format.
The 2026 NHL Playoffs include 16 teams total.
The 2026 NHL Playoffs include 8 teams per conference.
The top 3 teams from each division qualify for the 2026 NHL Playoffs.
There are 2 wild cards per conference in the 2026 NHL Playoffs.
As of April 4-5, 2026, the Florida Panthers are officially eliminated from playoff contention.
The 2026 NHL Playoffs will be broadcast on ESPN.
The 2026 NHL Playoffs will be broadcast on NHL on TNT.
The 2026 NHL Playoffs will be broadcast on Sportsnet.
The 2026 NHL Playoffs will be broadcast on TVA Sports.
The NHL.com bracket challenge will open once all 16 playoff seeds are finalized
